PR introduces a new `libbitcoin_kernel` internal library. It completes the internal library design as laid out in [doc/design/libraries.md](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/blob/master/doc/design/libraries.md). Since the `util` library contains a bunch of modules that are not required by the kernel library, a new `kernel_util` library is introduced as well that only consists of the modules required by the kernel library. The external `libbitcoinkernel` library now re-uses the compiled objects from the internal libraries. There is a trade-off to this. Since we don't manually export symbols from the kernel library yet, this would make the library unusable if `REDUCE_EXPORTS=ON`. For now this means that the patch here introduces a separate source file list for the external library that gets populated by the source files of its static dependents. 6b9f4a5075 Introduce internal kernel library To facilitate compiling the external kernel library with different symbol visibility, re-use the same source file list from its dependent internal counterpart. 54ecfc9692 Update docs and check-deps for util kernel lib contrib/devtools/check-deps.sh +12/-0 doc/design/libraries.md +17/-4 src/CMakeLists.txt +54/-37 src/kernel/CMakeLists.txt +16/-69 src/util/CMakeLists.txt +25/-12 src/wallet/CMakeLists.txt +2/-0 (test/bench/ci lines: 12) diff --git a/src/wallet/CMakeLists.txt b/src/wallet/CMakeLists.txt index 040569f7d6..4ca2ff1bfb 100644 --- a/src/wallet/CMakeLists.txt +++ b/src/wallet/CMakeLists.txt @@ -39,6 +39,8 @@ target_link_libraries(bitcoin_wallet PRIVATE core_interface bitcoin_common + bitcoin_kernel + bitcoin_util_kernel SQLite3::SQLite3 univalue Boost::headers diff --git a/contrib/devtools/check-deps.sh b/contrib/devtools/check-deps.sh index 0ae817254d..00dc1aad44 100755 --- a/contrib/devtools/check-deps.sh +++ b/contrib/devtools/check-deps.sh @@ -9,8 +9,10 @@ LIBS[cli]="libbitcoin_cli.a" LIBS[common]="libbitcoin_common.a" LIBS[consensus]="libbitcoin_consensus.a" LIBS[crypto]="libbitcoin_crypto.a" +LIBS[kernel]="libbitcoin_kernel.a" LIBS[node]="libbitcoin_node.a" LIBS[util]="libbitcoin_util.a" +LIBS[util_kernel]="libbitcoin_util_kernel.a" LIBS[wallet]="libbitcoin_wallet.a" # Declare allowed dependencies "X Y" where X is allowed to depend on Y.
